title: Feature Treatment and Bootstrap Stability in Clustering Orchard Microclimate Time Series
description: Analysis code and reproducibility package for the study "Feature treatment and bootstrap stability in clustering orchard microclimate time series". Aggregates a six-month hourly IoT record from a single durian orchard into daily features, contrasts a naive feature treatment against a physics-informed one that log-damps zero-inflated rain and stress-hour counts, and reports cluster-wise bootstrap Jaccard stability, Markov regime dynamics, dry-spell detection and an FAO-56 vapour-pressure-deficit provenance check.
